description: Mapas de cobertura del servicio fijo de Cablemás Telecomunicaciones is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Comisión Reguladora de Telecomunicaciones (CRT). Registros estructurados que muestran las características técnicas, despliegue de infraestructura y alcance del servicio fijo a nivel nacional. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Comisión Reguladora de Telecomunicaciones (CRT). Its tags are aplicación telecomunicaciones, cobertura, cobertura red, gobernanza internet, industria telecomunicaciones. It offers 8 resource(s) in GPKG. The portal shows 2026-09-08 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
